If it helps you at all, the zombie using pistol behaviour is COMPLETELY controlled by their DIFFICULTY.
So removing the high difficulty or whatever it was called, makes them only slow/fast (medium is fast) (easy is slow)
with that in mind and your adaptability you might figure out how to turn it into a working mod.
I only managed to figure that out by directly altering the files. Since I don’t do any Tarkov Scripting. Good luck!

Edit: you have to mostly modify whatever controls the spawns, which is inside the HalloweenZombies Event and the specific templates of each map which also adds Spawns for them so they appear on the map during raids (each location has like a setting for Halloween aswell)
